programs.title: Post Coitum Animal Triste
programs.desc: A middle-aged woman (Brigitte Rouan) abandons her family to embark on an affair with a younger man (Boris Terral).

programs.title: The Eagle Has Landed
programs.desc: 1943, The war is entering its final stages and Germany is teetering on the brink of defeat. An increasingly unhinged Hitler, orders a mission to have British Prime Minister Winston Churchill kidnapped and brought to Germany. The plan seems ludicrous in the extreme, but a message sent from a German spy in the Norfolk countryside makes one German officer realize that such a mission may just be feasible.

programs.title: Discovering Film
programs.desc: A look at the life and career of the two-time Academy Award-winning star of Spartacus, Topkapi, Quo Vadis and more.

programs.title: Moonlighting
programs.desc: Three Polish builders and their foreman arrive in London to renovate the home of a rich fellow Pole. The military crackdown in Poland is mirrored by a string of disasters for the builders, who have yet to learn of the turmoil back at home.

programs.title: Xanadu
programs.desc: Xanadu is a look at the future and a loving remembrance of the way things were in the heyday of Hollywood. The musical score includes the hit songs \.

programs.title: Walk The Line
programs.desc: Joaquin Phoenix stars as country music legend Johnny Cash. Cracking biopic of the Man in Black with Oscar-winning backing from Reese Witherspoon. Contains mature themes.
